affecting_alerts.description:
[N] train service between 36 St (Bklyn) and Coney Island-Stillwell Av has resumed. 
[R] train service between 36 St (Bklyn) and Bay Ridge-95 St has resumed. 
What Happened?
NYPD is conducted an investigation at Bay Ridge Av.

While trains get back on schedule, consider these alternatives:
For service to/from Coney Island-Stillwell Av, consider taking a [D][F][Q] train.

For [N][R] service between 36 St and 59 St, take a B11, B63 or B37 bus.
For [N] service between 59 St and Coney Island-Stillwell Av, take a B64 bus.
For [R] service between 59 St and Bay Ridge-95 St, take a B63 or B70 bus.

For connecting service between [N], [F], and [B][Q] trains along Kings Hwy, take a B82 or B82-SBS bus.
